Fictional outpatient letter | generated-010 | age 50
Consultation: 2025-02-01

Dx: established focal epilepsy.

Pattern A: staring sz, patient reports 2 to 4/month, 1 Nov 2024–1 Feb 2025. Clinician: epileptic.

Pattern B: separate right-hand jerks; clinician: epileptic. Patient: 1 to 2 clusters/month, 3 to 5 jerks/cluster, active 1 Nov 2024–1 Feb 2025 alongside A.

Lamotrigine proposed 15 Jan 2025. Actual start not established today.

EEG requested 10 Jan 2025. Result information omitted.

Fictional outpatient letter | generated-010 | age 50
Consultation: 2025-07-15

Patient: same A and separate B active 2 Feb–15 Jul 2025. A staring: 2 to 4/month. B right-hand jerks: 1 to 2 clusters/month, 3 to 5/cluster. Clinician: both epileptic.

Patient: never taken lamotrigine, entire history through 15 Jul 2025. Jan proposal not enacted.

Fictional outpatient letter | generated-010 | age 50
Consultation: 2025-08-20

Patient confirms lamotrigine started 25 Jul 2025, after Jul clinic.

EEG: the 10 Jan request; normal report first available to team 20 Feb 2025.
